binary_policy: Only project-generated figures, thesis/release/review PDFs and template EPS; no downloaded article PDFs, research signal arrays, weights, installation or videos.
other_user_work: All apps/tests/docs/progress/references and root archives left unstaged.
note: Local tool/cache/generated exclusions are aggregated; original files retained. No installation file list needed in remote evidence.

whitespace_check.action: Preserve historical files and frozen hashes; no bulk whitespace mutation; warnings disclosed.
whitespace_check.CRLF_policy: Preserve raw bytes; cr-at-eol recognized as EOL, no trailing-space check suppression
